policies.title: 助動詞・be動詞の発音
policies.question: 冠詞・前置詞などの機能語は弱く読む形（the /ðə/、for /fər/）に決まりました。助動詞・be動詞（do /də/、was /wəz/、have /həv/、must /məst/ など）も弱く読む形にするか。can は前回のご指摘で弱く読む形（/kən/）にしています。
policies.question_en: Function words such as articles and prepositions are now registered in the weak form (the /ðə/, for /fər/). Should auxiliaries and be-verbs (do /də/, was /wəz/, have /həv/, must /məst/, etc.) also use the weak form? can already uses the weak form (/kən/) based on your previous comment.
policies.current: 強く読む形（例: was /wʌz/ MUSTARD、have /hæv/ BLACK CAT、do /duː/ BLUE MOON）
policies.current_en: Strong form (e.g. was /wʌz/ MUSTARD, have /hæv/ BLACK CAT, do /duː/ BLUE MOON)
policies.candidates: 強く読む形 / 弱く読む形
options: 強く読む形のままでよい
